title: Homemade Chocolate Peanut Butter

ingredients.as_written: 2 tbsp of Monkfruit Extract (Can replace with honey)

steps: Roast the Peanuts on medium flame until they turn dark brown. Let them cool down.
Now wrap the peanuts in a cloth and rub the cloth well which will help separate the skin.
Now use a sieve to collect the skin or just blow some air onto the plate and the skin will fly away (make sure to do this over a sink though).
Blend the peanuts for 10-15 seconds and then add salt.
Blend again until you see a creamy consistency.
Add Cocoa Powder and the sweetner. Blend again for 20-30 seconds and its ready!!
Store in an airtight jar and pair with jam for the best PBJ Sandwich ever.
assumptions: The ingredient list also names honey as an alternative or note; it isn’t listed separately.
